summary: Archived Tracks 02, 03 and 04 satisfy the hard-start contracts; archived Tracks 05 and 06 satisfy later benchmark and multimodal dependencies. Work is limited to generated synthetic and already admitted public descriptors. External or restricted corpora, cross-compartment queries, remote embeddings and operational retrieval thresholds remain gated.

Acceptance, security and falsification agents independently replayed the bounded retrieval threats and recorded ACCEPT after rework. This records agent agreement only and is not human or external-authority approval.

Deterministic compartment-bound lexical retrieval, provenance, rights and poisoning admission, lifecycle/audit, literature/SourceRight negative contracts and verifier-bound assurance are complete. Vector, hybrid, reranking, provider, private federation and operational thresholds remain explicitly unsupported.
